description: Run user tests and UX research without leaving your agent: plan a study from a research question, draft studies (surveys, usability tests, tree tests, card sorts, five-second tests, preference tests, first-click tests, prototype tests), recruit participants from Your Panel, AI Panel, or GenPop Panel, analyze findings and individual responses, and work with Projects, personas and AI panels. Use usersage-plan to plan a study (any plan), usersage-draft to create it, usersage-recruit to launch recruitment, usersage-results to analyze what came back, and usersage-workspace for Projects, personas and panels. Every other plugin queries systems; this one queries people.
name: user-sage
